name: imap-dashboard
description: A clear mailbox side panel for the existing IMAP Plugin connection on Windows or macOS.

interface.shortDescription: Your IMAP mailbox in a side panel
interface.longDescription: Read and manage an IMAP mailbox from a clear Codex side panel. It uses the existing IMAP Plugin connection, so the mailbox login is entered only once and remains protected by the operating system.
defaultPrompt: Show the most important action for the selected message.
